**A counterculture campus that built Ceph**

> 反主流文化校园造出 Ceph

## Why it matters (为何重要)

UCSC pairs an experimental, interdisciplinary spirit with serious systems work — Ceph and the Pacman assignments both live here.

> UCSC 把实验性的跨学科精神与扎实的系统工作结合——Ceph 与 Pacman 作业都诞生于此。

## Background (背景)

Founded in 1965 as an experimental public campus, its Information and Computer Science department formed in the late 1960s and the Baskin School of Engineering was named in 1997.

> 1965 年作为实验性公立校区创办，信息与计算机科学系在 1960 年代末成立，1997 年工程学院以 Baskin 命名。

## In this book (本书收录)

- [031 · Pacman warmup (CSE 140 p0)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/031-ucsc-cse140-pacman-warmup)

**Both Pacman projects come straight from CSE 140: first build a shop argmin, then the full search stack — DFS, BFS, UCS, A* — on the same framework.**

> 两个 Pacman 项目都直接来自 CSE 140：先做商店取优，再在同一框架上完成 DFS、BFS、UCS、A* 全套搜索。
